rooms.name: The Gridlock
rooms.description: Step 1 — A congested digital highway. Data packets frozen mid-transit under a giant sign: HUMAN VERIFICATION: QUEUE FULL.
rooms.unlock_text: Jakarta's MRT pipeline is stuck. The signage will go dark in 45 minutes.

rooms.name: The Control Tower
rooms.description: The glass-walled hub. Screens showing stage graphs and agent status. A conductor's podium waits in the center.
rooms.unlock_text: The Old Way falls away. Only the Conductor can clear the traffic.

rooms.name: The Stage Graph
rooms.description: A wall-sized FSM diagram — 32 stages of AI-DLC V2. Two flash red. Route the agents. Compose the workflow.
rooms.unlock_text: FSM engine restarted. The graph comes online.

rooms.name: The Inner Loop
rooms.description: Parallel path A — a testing lab where AI generates and AI verifies. The inner loop, if you can trust it.
rooms.unlock_text: The Composer scored the fix. 14 stages. Path A opens.

rooms.name: The Memory Vault
rooms.description: Parallel path B — a library of ORG / TEAM / PROJECT rules. Some drawers are open. Some text is corrupting.
rooms.unlock_text: The Composer scored the fix. 14 stages. Path B opens.

rooms.name: The Composer's Studio
rooms.description: A 32-channel mixing console. A holographic Golem overloaded with every stage. Right-size the workflow.
rooms.unlock_text: Sub-agents cleared. Raja: 'Go right-size the bloated workflow.'

rooms.name: The Verification Lab
rooms.description: Two glass chambers: LLM inference (blue) and computational tools (green). A prompt-assembly workbench between them.
rooms.unlock_text: Golem unloaded. The verification chambers glow.

rooms.name: The Sub-Agent Bay
rooms.description: Parallel path A — deployment bay with specialist agent pods. Some powered on, some dark. Discover the ones you need.
rooms.unlock_text: Verification prompt assembled. Path A opens.

rooms.name: The Audit Trail
rooms.description: Parallel path B — a dark room, a single terminal streaming 72 event types. Some entries are corrupt — red glitches flicker through.
rooms.unlock_text: Verification prompt assembled. Path B opens.

rooms.name: The Conductor's Podium
rooms.description: The central podium. All agents await your signal. Verification protocol and memory rules slot into place.
rooms.unlock_text: Sub-agents online. The podium awaits The Conductor.

rooms.name: The Release Gate
rooms.description: The pipeline turns green node by node. The Jakarta MRT map lights up station by station.
rooms.unlock_text: The orchestra played. The release ships. The traffic clears.

rooms.name: The Learning Loop
rooms.description: A quiet reflection room. The pipeline replays itself on a timeline. A final terminal asks: shall we encode what we learned?
rooms.unlock_text: The city is safe. Now — encode the learnings so tomorrow is faster.
